name: Agent Tool Routing
description: 1,200 synthetic requests to an AI agent, each labeled with the single tool it should call: web_search, calculator, calendar, send_email, weather, database_query, code_execution, or no_tool for requests answerable directly.
task: Which tool should the agent call to handle this request?

labels.name: web_search
labels.description: Searches the public internet for fresh or external information: news and current events, live prices and exchange rates, sports results, recent releases and versions, facts that change over time (current office-holders, statistics), and finding websites, businesses, documentation or reviews. Weather requests use weather; the company's own records use database_query; stable textbook facts need no_tool.

labels.name: calculator
labels.description: Evaluates math on numbers the user supplies: arithmetic, percentages, tips, discounts, averages, interest or loan formulas, and unit conversions with fixed factors (miles/km, °F/°C, hours/minutes). Applies whenever every input number is in the message; conversions that need live rates are web_search, totals over company records are database_query, and running user-supplied code is code_execution.

labels.name: calendar
labels.description: Reads and edits the user's own calendar: create, schedule, move, extend, cancel, decline or list meetings and events, and check free/busy time. If the user only wants people notified by email or message, that is send_email.

labels.name: send_email
labels.description: Composes and sends an email or message to a specific recipient on the user's behalf, including replies and forwards. Applies whenever something should be sent or someone notified, even if the content mentions meetings, numbers or code; writing a draft or template the user will send themselves is no_tool.

labels.name: weather
labels.description: Returns current conditions or forecasts — temperature, rain, snow, wind, humidity, UV, storms — for a place and time, even when the user says 'search' or 'look up'. Converting a temperature value the user already gives is calculator; writing about weather is no_tool.

labels.name: database_query
labels.description: Queries the company's internal database/CRM: customers and contacts, orders and their status, invoices and amounts owed, inventory and stock levels, returns, sales figures and reps — including counts, totals and averages computed over those records. Data in a file the user uploads or attaches is code_execution.

labels.name: code_execution
labels.description: Runs code in a sandbox: executes or tests a snippet or script the user provides, or writes and runs code to analyze, plot or transform an uploaded/attached file (CSV, JSON, SQLite) or to run a simulation. Wins over calculator when the user supplies code to run; only explaining code or a programming concept is no_tool.

labels.name: no_tool
labels.description: No tool is needed and the agent answers directly: chit-chat and thanks, opinions and advice, creative writing (poems, jokes, names), rewriting or translating text the user provides, drafting templates the user will send themselves, and explaining stable general knowledge or concepts. Anything needing fresh data, a computation, the user's calendar or mailbox, company records or running code needs a tool.
